$comment: Search configuration for the daily discovery pipeline. Edit freely — no pipeline code needs to change. Each query records its own id on every observation it produces, so noisy queries can be identified and retired from the data.

queries.query: ("Erdős problem" OR "Erdos problem") (AI OR LLM OR GPT OR Gemini OR Claude)
(conjecture) ("solved by AI" OR "AI solved" OR "disproved by AI" OR "counterexample found by")
"open problem" (AI OR LLM) (solved OR resolved OR refuted)
(Lean4 OR "Lean 4" OR Mathlib) (AI OR LLM OR GPT OR Gemini) (proof OR formalized OR formalised)
"automated theorem proving" OR "machine-generated proof" OR "AI-generated proof"
counterexample (AI OR LLM OR GPT OR Gemini OR Claude) (conjecture OR theorem)
OEIS (conjecture OR sequence) (AI OR LLM OR proved)
Aletheia (math OR mathematics OR conjecture OR proof)
Aristotle Harmonic (math OR proof OR Lean)
OpenAI (mathematics OR conjecture OR "Erdős") (proof OR solved OR disproved)
"Graffiti conjecture" OR "Graffiti.pc" OR "Written on the Wall"

accounts.$comment: Highly trusted researchers, labs, formal-methods projects and problem databases. Queried with from: so their posts are always seen even when the topical queries miss them.
accounts.queryTemplate: from:{handle} (conjecture OR theorem OR proof OR problem OR Lean OR Erdős)
